brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stack of half bases at level 0 (piece:0,0,0;half-n + piece:0,-1,0;half-s) and level 1 (piece:0,0,1;half-n + piece:0,-1,1;half-s) with top covers capped and joint-bolted, total height 160 mm
Two drawers fitted: drawer:0#0,0#cut on lower storey and drawer:1#0,-1#cut on upper storey, each with compartments dressed with workshop props
Dressed with workshop props: tape measure on top deck (prop:1), pliers in lower drawer (prop:2), hex key set in upper drawer (prop:3), visible in look from 45°

finish.summary: Built a compact two-storey tower from half-hex bases stacked to 160 mm, capped with half covers, joint-bolted, with two cut-face drawers (one per storey) demonstrating workbench storage. Dressed with tape measure, pliers and hex keys.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
